title: Personal Loans AutoPay Discount Step for Loan Age
content:
## Rule

A loan-age AutoPay discount step applies to a Personal Loans AutoPay enrollment, counting whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) from the funding date to the enrollment date: 36 or more add 0.1 point; 24 to 35 add 0.05 point; fewer than 24 add no step.

A step is added to the AutoPay discount by which the loan's base interest rate is reduced from the enrollment date; the rate is rounded to two decimals once, at the end.

| Whole months from funding to enrollment | Step |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0.10 point |
| 24 to 35 | 0.05 point |
| fewer than 24 | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, funded on 12 August)

| Enrollment date | Whole months | Step |
|---|---|---|
| 11 August two years later | 23 | none |
| 12 August two years later | 24 | 0.05 |
| 11 August three years later | 35 | 0.05 |
| 12 August three years later | 36 | 0.10 |

A hypothetical Grade A loan with a base rate of 9.00 and a 0.10 step: 9.00 less 0.50 and 0.10 is 8.40.
